data.name: Kitty Powers' Matchmaker Makeover
data.detailed_description:
It's time to make love happen, again!

Step back into the role of trainee matchmaker, and help quirky clients find their perfect match, all under the 'expert' supervision of British Drag Queen and matchmaking maven, Kitty Powers!

Can you restore her neglected dating agencies to their full potential?

Can you become a Matchmaking Maestro?

This remastered version has been rebuilt from the ground up and features vibrant new artwork, expanded customization options, and a host of gameplay improvements to make matchmaking even more fun and inclusive.

Features

  • Enhanced Artwork: Feast your eyes on Matchmaker’s enhanced assets and sumptuously high definition artwork. Now with 4K and ultra-widescreen modes!

  • New and Improved Mini-games: Tackle four brand new dating dilemmas including ‘Fling the Food’, ‘Rose or Knickers’ and ‘Divide the Dessert’, as well as numerous improved minigames from the original!

  • New and Expanded Game Mechanics: Get to grips with new mechanics such as ‘Chemistry’ and ‘Juicy Secrets’ to take your matchmaking to new heights!

  • Expanded Customization: Players have new options to dress and style their characters, with updated personalities and fashion that ensures anything goes!

  • More Diversity: Choose from male, female and non-binary characters, who can be straight, gay, bisexual or pansexual!

  • Salon Makeover: Meet your new personal stylist, who will help you spruce up your characters up for their big night with upgradeable salon treatments!

  • The Return of Kitty Powers: The iconic drag queen is back with her signature witty commentary, guiding players on their matchmaking journey!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11 or DX12 capable GPU
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: Big Sur 11.0+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal capable GPU
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
